source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: When I copy content from the old document into the new one, it looks great. There is only one minor issue: could the spacing be reduced so everything fits within three pages?

routing_warnings.description: The opening clause separately verifies that content copied from the old document looks correct; that observation belongs to legacy-content paste stability rather than page fit.
The excessive spacing described here concerns hard returns in continuous text, which is narrower than overall document density and page fit.
The 0.18 row and column spacing claim addresses local text-to-border padding rather than overall document page fit.
The concrete failure concerns Enter-key input in a field; the accompanying spacing question depends on the local padding exchange and does not establish an overall page-fit event.
